description: 실행형 리뷰 근거입니다. 각 `baseline`/`candidate` 파일을 격리 디렉터리에 구성하고 `node --test producer.test.mjs`와 별도 계약 `oracle`을 `node --input-type=module -e`로 실행합니다. `oracle` 결과는 판정 전까지 응답 좌석에 공개하지 않습니다. 이 `fixture` 자체가 모델 리뷰를 대신하지 않습니다.

baseline_files.SPEC.md: Return exactly five results; the downstream screen requires five.

candidate_files.SPEC.md: Return exactly five results; the downstream screen requires five.

baseline_files.SPEC.md: Return exactly five results; the downstream screen requires five.

candidate_files.SPEC.md: Approved revision: return one representative result; the downstream screen now requires one.

baseline_files.SPEC.md: A failed save must reject and the caller must display failure.
baseline_files.consumer.mjs: import {save} from './producer.mjs';export async function screen(adapter){try{await save(adapter);return 'success';}catch{return 'failure';}}
baseline_files.producer.mjs: export async function save(adapter){return await adapter.save();}
baseline_files.producer.test.mjs: import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {save} from './producer.mjs';test('failure propagated',async()=>assert.rejects(save({save:async()=>{throw Error('disk');}})));

candidate_files.SPEC.md: A failed save must reject and the caller must display failure.
candidate_files.consumer.mjs: import {save} from './producer.mjs';export async function screen(adapter){try{await save(adapter);return 'success';}catch{return 'failure';}}
candidate_files.producer.mjs: export async function save(adapter){try{return await adapter.save();}catch{return {ok:true};}}
candidate_files.producer.test.mjs: import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {save} from './producer.mjs';test.skip('failure propagated',()=>{});test('called',async()=>{let calls=0;await save({save:async()=>{calls++;throw Error('disk');}});assert.equal(calls,1);});

cases.baseline_oracle: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {screen} from './consumer.mjs';assert.equal(await screen({save:async()=>{throw Error('disk');}}),'failure');
cases.candidate_oracle: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {screen} from './consumer.mjs';assert.equal(await screen({save:async()=>{throw Error('disk');}}),'failure');

baseline_files.SPEC.md: All registered plugins, including legacy, must load.
baseline_files.loader.mjs: import fs from 'node:fs';export async function load(){const names=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('./registry.json',import.meta.url)));return Promise.all(names.map(name=>import(`./plugins/${name}.mjs`)));}
baseline_files.producer.test.mjs: import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {load} from './loader.mjs';test('registered plugin',async()=>assert.equal((await load())[0].default,'ready'));

candidate_files.SPEC.md: All registered plugins, including legacy, must load.
candidate_files.loader.mjs: import fs from 'node:fs';export async function load(){const names=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('./registry.json',import.meta.url)));return Promise.all(names.map(name=>import(`./plugins/${name}.mjs`)));}
candidate_files.producer.test.mjs: import {test} from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {load} from './loader.mjs';test('registered plugin',async()=>assert.equal((await load())[0].default,'ready'));

baseline_files.SPEC.md: Every emitted event must retain its user identifier in the screen and audit output. Field renaming is allowed only with consumer compatibility.
baseline_files.consumer.mjs: import {produce} from './producer.mjs';import {audit} from './audit.mjs';export const screen=()=>produce().userId;export const auditEvent=()=>audit(produce());
